title: *PSY101 GDB - Physical Development and Nature-Nurture Issue*
text:
*PSY101 GDB - Physical Development and Nature-Nurture Issue*
Physical development means growth of body, brain, height, weight and motor skills from birth to old age. It happens in stages like infancy, childhood and adolescence. Nature means genes we get from parents like eye colour, height and natural health. Nurture means environment around us like healthy food, parents love, care, school and culture. Both nature and nurture work together for good growth. For example, a child may have genes for tall height but without good food and care his growth will stay weak. Also a child with normal genes can become very healthy and active if he gets good nutrition and training. So physical development is not only nature or only nurture. Best growth needs both healthy genes and good environment together.
